question.note: Representation by own elected officials (Q3), plus officials' motives, which the paper names as a purpose (p.4).
Offsetting the ad's harm (Q2) and reducing support for using the ad (H1A, Q4).
Pre-registered supplemental heterogeneity by system-impact status (p.7); accurate, not a gold question.

central_claim.note: Both halves of the trade-off and the near-complete offset ('almost entirely ameliorated', p.15).

evidence.note: Prolific, July 12-13 2025, U.S. Democrats; pre-registration is given in entry 6. Matched in full as the earlier judge did for a Prolific/Democrats description without pre-registration.
Attention checks, duplicates, completion codes and likely nonhuman (bot) responses removed; final N 2,439.
Sample demographics (p.8); accurate, not a gold answer.
Three arms with counts; ordering of outcomes and stimuli accurate (p.5).
Ad half of E3 (mugshot labeled CONVICTED CRIMINAL, in the quote; claim says 'captioned in capital letters').
Counter-narrative half of E3: edited Nevada Current excerpt about formerly incarcerated lawmaker Jackson.
Supplies the pre-registration part of E1 (already matched in entry 0); the two hypothesis sets are accurate.
Measurement format of the outcomes; part of E4.
Five-item perceptions index is part of E4; its low-end reliability (alpha 0.71, p.7) is the first half of the L7 limitation, as the earlier judge credited.
Two-item ad support index (part of E4) and the emotional-reaction manipulation check (E7).
OLS with HC-2 SEs, treatment-only and covariate models; balance result is an accurate extra.
Supplemental analyses listed (p.11-12); accurate, not a gold answer.

key_findings.note: Keeps 'before seeing the ad' and 'compared with seeing the ad alone'.

F3: ad raised representation and public-service motives. F5: counter-narrative lowered federal Democratic representation vs ad alone. F11 partial: Bonferroni caveat given for the ad-vs-control motives result only, not the counter-narrative comparison.
H1C 0.79 SD increase is accurate but not in the gold (as the earlier judge treated it); the complexity null is F9.
Item-level split (only explicit support significant) is accurate (p.11).

scope_and_limits.note: Preliminary evidence; replication in other contexts/less transparent designs is accurate (p.17) but durability is not in the claim.
Also the moderation point (p.16, ref 76), accurate.
Narrow representation measures, second half of L7.
Index reliability satisfactory but not strong, first half of L7.
States the deservingness-versus-stigma-reduction possibility but not that the author thinks stigma reduction more likely (the quote has it).
Long-term implications for solidarity left for future research (p.18); accurate, not a gold limit.

theoretical_positioning.note: Perspective-getting and counter-stereotype; the policy-alignment signal is the paper's own rationale (p.3-4).
Reported as tentative, as the paper does.

interlocutor_claim.note: Refs 8-10 are Denver, Ballou & DeWitt; Harris & Socia; Imhoff (paper.xml): attribution correct.
